track_record.rule_text: GG's trade math (your answer, 2026-10-16). Entry = the trigger the alert gave: the first 1-minute bar from 09:45 ET to 16:00 ET (your answer: from 09:45 ET only) that starts 30 s or more after the alert and trades at or above the trigger fills — at the trigger, or at that bar's open when it opened above it (a gap fills at the open). WIN = a later 1-minute high reaches the fill +1R (R = trigger − stop, as the alert gave them) before any low touches the stop. LOSS = the stop is touched first; a bar that touches both counts as a loss, and so does a stop touched in the fill minute. Same session = through 16:00 ET on the alert's day (an alert at or after 16:00 ET: through 16:00 ET of the next market day, its first regular session); through next session = the same walk to 16:00 ET of the market day after that, after-hours and pre-market prints included. The % is the best high after the fill against the fill; the small % is the column's last close against the fill. No entry and no plan are listed, never counted; a thin R (under 0.5% of the trigger) is graded and kept out of the %.
